ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure there are oval boxes such as “high per-unit yield”, “high productivity”, and “high commodity rate”; on the left side there are condition boxes such as “superior natural conditions” and “convenient transportation”; a, b, c, and d are location conditions to be filled in. c is located on the lower left side of the figure; in terms of position, it is not connected to “high per-unit yield” or “high productivity”, but instead together with “convenient transportation” below points to or serves “high commodity rate”. Then reason: the question stem states that commercial grain agriculture is market-oriented, and one of its basic characteristics is a high commodity rate. The socioeconomic location conditions affecting a high commodity rate usually include convenient transportation and a broad market. Therefore, the location condition corresponding to c is “broad market”.
